page: Microsoft Azure D32ps_v5 is a general-purpose server instance belonging to the DPSv5 family. It is powered by an ARM64-based Ampere Altra processor utilizing the ARMv8 Neoverse-N1 microarchitecture. The server features 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs running at 3.0 GHz, with no hyperthreading. It is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core. There is no bundled local storage or GPU hardware, though the instance is Premium Storage capable.

Performance benchmarks place the D32ps_v5 in the average tier for most multi-core and memory-bound operations. It achieves a stress-ng multi-core CPU score of 57217.14 and a PassMark CPU score of 20115.76. Memory bandwidth is solid, with read-only cached small block speeds reaching 2231.53 GB/sec and uncached large block write speeds at 77.1 GB/sec. However, single-core performance is a notable tradeoff, with Geekbench single-core and text processing scores falling into the weak category. Large language model inference is also a bottleneck, showing poor performance on 70B models.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ARM64 architecture offers a resource-dense profile for multi-threaded workloads without the overhead of hyperthreading. This makes the instance highly suitable for scale-out applications, static web serving, database operations, and software compilation. It is less suited for single-threaded tasks or large-scale AI inference workloads.
